what: A SID chip groovebox that talks. Six tracks of C64 SID voices and SAM speech, per-step sound locks, conditions, ratchets and MIDI FX, and a tower of eight retro effects with a send per track. Bluetooth MIDI and USB audio. A C64 game for a screen.
author: Quixotic7
sounds: own: presets by the author; words spoken by SAM in the firmware
